correctness.rationale: The exact card-move increment yields an exact autoregression for centered inversions. Conditional on distinct touched cards the permutation has a uniformly shuffled front and increasing untouched tail; its weak empirical limit computes the conditional square-increment function explicitly. Bounded jumps, uniform bracket convergence and the standard martingale functional CLT give tight path convergence. A deterministic Volterra map yields the stated diffusion. Covariance integration reproduces the independently known one-time variance. The exact checker enumerates all small-card regressions and variance identities. The result is restricted to uniform selection, ordered initial deck and bounded rescaled times.

value.rationale: The stochastic temporal dependence is not determined by the motivating fixed-time CLT: the result supplies joint fluctuations for arbitrarily many times, a continuous Gaussian Markov evolution, explicit nonstationary diffusion intensity, and exact covariance across times. This is a natural process-level strengthening in mixing statistics, not a table recomputation or a routine algebraic rescaling; no universality beyond uniform shuffle selection is asserted.
